metaTitle: Brazil IRPF Income Tax Calculator 2026 | Calculaderia

form.title: Annual inputs for an IRPF estimate

helpers.period: Choose filing year 2026 for calendar year 2025, or the 2026 calendar-year estimate for exercício 2027.
helpers.income: Enter annual totals. Only taxable income enters the progressive annual table in this estimate.
helpers.informationalIncome: Informational field; it does not change the main progressive calculation in this MVP.
helpers.deductions: Enter only values you understand as eligible. The calculator applies numeric caps, but does not validate documentation or legal entitlement.
helpers.complementaryPension: PGBL/Fapi-style complementary pension is capped at 12% of the taxable income entered.
helpers.method: In automatic mode, the calculator compares legal deductions and the simplified discount by the lower final tax.

howEstimate.title: How the calculator estimates IRPF
howEstimate.p1: The estimate starts from annual taxable income entered by the user, applies legal deductions or the simplified discount, and uses the annual progressive table for the selected calendar year.
howEstimate.p2: After tax due, it offsets IRRF, Carnê-Leão/DARF, and complementary tax already paid to estimate tax payable or refund.

yearModes.title: 2026 filing x 2026 calendar year
yearModes.p1: The 2026 filing option uses calendar year 2025, the common basis for the IRPF 2026 filing season.
yearModes.p2: The calendar-year 2026 option is an estimate for exercício 2027, with the 2026 annual reduction shown separately.

deductions.title: Legal deductions and simplified discount
deductions.p1: The legal path adds official social security, dependents, alimony, medical expenses, capped education, capped complementary pension, livro-caixa, and other entered deductions.
deductions.p2: The simplified discount uses 20% of taxable income up to the annual cap. Automatic mode chooses the lower final tax.

balance.title: Tax payable vs refund
balance.text: A positive balance means estimated tax payable; a negative balance means estimated refund; zero means tax due and paid tax match after rounding.

limits.title: Limits of this estimate
limits.text: The calculator does not decide filing obligation, validate receipts, generate DARF, or cover capital gains, stock/crypto, foreign income, rural activity, donations, fines, interest, or special cases.

disclaimer.title: Important notice
disclaimer.text: This tool is an educational annual IRPF estimate based on user-entered totals and official table values accessed on 2026-06-26. It does not provide filing, legal, accounting, or tax advice, is not an official Receita Federal calculator, and does not replace Receita systems or professional review.

q1.question: Does this calculator replace Receita Federal filing?
q1.answer: No. It estimates the annual adjustment with user-entered values and does not send, validate, or replace the official declaration.

q2.question: Which year should I choose?
q2.answer: Use calendar year 2025 for the IRPF 2026 filing. Use calendar year 2026 only as an estimate for exercício 2027.

q3.question: What goes into taxable income?
q3.answer: Enter the annual total subject to progressive adjustment based on your reports and records. Correct income classification remains your responsibility.

q4.question: Simplified discount or legal deductions?
q4.answer: In automatic mode, the calculator compares both paths and uses the lower final tax. You can also force a method to inspect the difference.

q5.question: Why do exempt and exclusive/final-taxed income not enter the main calculation?
q5.answer: They are shown as context because they do not compose this version's annual progressive base. Specific cases may need official filing review.

q6.question: Can I use the result to pay DARF?
q6.answer: Do not use this estimate as payment guidance. Generate and check DARF only in Receita Federal systems or with professional guidance.

q7.question: Are my data saved?
q7.answer: The calculation runs in the browser. When you share or save a favorite, entered values become part of the generated URL.
